messages:
alice_dev: quick post-canary notes for emerald-13b: enabled speculative stitching + q4-emul. saw solid p50/p95 wins but a concentrated regression on templated-fill tests. saving raw notes here.
rachel_ml: can you drop the top-line numbers?
alice_dev: small summary we exported:
```csv
variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,templated_fail_pct,avg_top2_gap
baseline,140,360,0.5,2.1
spec+q4-emul,98,240,2.4,1.5
spec-only,110,265,0.7,2.0
q4-emul-only,135,330,1.2,1.8
```
jin-ml: failure mode looks like single-token off-by-one in slots (dates, amounts) not freeform chat. that smells like commit timing + small logit bias.
tom_ops: two shards rolled back; their KV hit rate dipped during a short GC spike. ops traces attached to the job.
eval-bot: Canary job emerald-2026-03-18-09 completed (8/10 shards success). Logs: /s3/canaries/emerald/1848888000/ (sanitized).
rachel_ml: hypothesis: q4-emul reduces top2 gap; spec stitches on lower margin decisions -> wrong slot token locked. need token-stability metric.
alice_dev: agreed. planned followups:
- instrument per-token top1/top2 gap at commit and after quant kernel
- run targeted holdout on templated-fill suite with deterministic RNG
- sweep speculative "stitch_threshold" in [0.45,0.6,0.8] and cap lookahead to 2
- try q8-emul as middle step to see continuity
- add a tiny adversarial set where we perturb trailing whitespace and punctuation

jin-ml: also add a per-token flip-rate between fp32 reference and quantized kernel; that should highlight tokens most sensitive to quant noise.
tom_ops: schedule note: will place 12 shards for the sweep, staggered to avoid cluster-wide evict storms.
alice_dev: small perf note: speculative + q4 gave ~30% p95 drop on busy tails, good for throughput. but tradeoff might be unacceptable for templated flows.
rachel_ml: let's gate rollout behind templated-suite passing at remediated thresholds. otherwise keep spec-only for now.
eval-bot: job scheduled: spec-emerald-sweep-184888 (created by alice_dev). ETA 6h.
jin-ml: i'll wire the histogram exporter (token ids + numeric diffs only). ping @rachel_ml for quick review.
alice_dev: privacy reminder: scrub inputs; keep only token ids & numeric metrics in artifacts.
tom_ops: ACK. posting sanitized artifact link once jobs finish.
alice_dev: thanks all. will post the A/B summaries and a short decision note once we have sweep data.
